hideBreadcrumbs.description: Breadcrumbs show on every page except the home page unless hidden.

theme.description: Theme applied to the whole page.

publishedAt.description: Listings sort by this date, newest first.

excerpt.description: Shown on cards and as the default meta description.

blocks.description: Optional sections rendered below the body.

utilityLinks.description: Small links in a bar above the header, e.g. contact, locations, sign in.

footerHeading.description: Heading of the band at the top of the footer. The band shows when set.

footerText.description: Supporting line under the footer band heading.

footerSignupEndpoint.description: Email sign-up in the footer band posts here as JSON ({ email }). Leave empty for no sign-up.

footerSignupLabel.description: Sign-up button label. Defaults to Subscribe.

footerTagline.description: Short description under the logo in the footer.

contactDetails.description: Address, phone and email, shown in the footer's split layout.

legalLinks.description: Privacy, terms, cookies. Shown on the footer's bottom row.

components.name: gallery
components.description: Photos and videos in a grid, masonry, featured, stage or scroll-driven strip layout, with an optional lightbox.

layout.description: grid: equal tiles; masonry: natural heights in columns; featured: the first item large; stage: one large image with a thumbnail row; strip: a row that moves sideways as the page scrolls.

lightbox.description: Open items full screen on tap, with previous and next.

autoplay.description: Stage layout only: advance every few seconds, with a pause control.

components.description: Paginated, filterable listing of a document type, driven by the URL's search params.

layout.description: grid: cards. list: rows with a thumbnail. featured: the newest item large, the rest as cards. compact: title and date only.

search.description: Show a search box. Searches use the CMS's own search and are never cached.

sort.description: Default order; visitors can change it.

components.name: latestNews
components.description: The newest few items of a document type, for a home page or landing page, with a link to the full listing.

category.description: Only show items in this category. Empty shows every category.

count.description: How many items; the grid always fills.

layout.description: Same layouts as the collection block. featured shows the newest item large.

actions.description: The "see all" link. Left empty, it links to the page that lists this type.

components.name: action
components.description: A call-to-action link rendered as a button.

magnetic.description: Pull the button towards the pointer on hover (mouse only). Inherit follows the site setting.

values.description: One value per column. Use 'yes' / 'no' for check and cross icons.

components.name: navColumn
components.description: A titled column of links inside a mega menu panel.

components.name: navGroup
components.description: A top-level navigation entry. With links it opens a dropdown; with columns it opens a mega menu panel.

columns.description: Titled columns of links. When set, the group opens a mega menu panel instead of a dropdown.

feature.description: Optional featured card at the end of the mega menu panel.

components.name: textItem
components.description: One entry of a text list.
